description: This Java class defines an action to run the Android SDK Manager within an IDE environment, handling different invocation contexts such as welcome screen or project environment, and managing external process execution with progress indication.

classes.name: RunAndroidSdkManagerAction
classes.description: An action class to launch the Android SDK Manager, handling UI updates and process execution.

methods.name: updateInWelcomePage
methods.description: Updates the SDK Manager action availability on the welcome page when no projects are open.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name for the SDK Manager action.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Enables or disables the action based on context, especially on the welcome screen.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles the action event to launch the SDK Manager, either via wizard or external process.

methods.name: runSpecificSdkManager
methods.description: Static method to run SDK Manager for a specific SDK home directory.

methods.name: doRunTool
methods.description: Initiates the process to run the SDK Manager, choosing between internal wizard or external process.

methods.name: launchExternalSdkManager
methods.description: Launches the external SDK Manager process with progress indication and error handling.
